default_policy.review_rule: Each run is limited to one normalized public HTTP(S) host supplied by the user. Redirect targets are revalidated and must stay on that host.

scripts/run_site_diagnose.py.purpose: Fetch a bounded public website sample and create a local GEO diagnosis artifact directory.
scripts/run_site_diagnose.py.requires_https: preferred; public HTTP is accepted when explicitly supplied by the user
scripts/run_site_diagnose.py.custom_url_policy: GET only; no credentials, fragments, queries, login paths, forms, downloads, off-host redirects, private addresses, or private DNS resolutions; browser dependencies remain same-host and policy-checked
